tests.label: 900 layers of 2: a huge number of routes

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(2102)
n = 2000
order = list(range(n))
r.shuffle(order)
seen, pairs = set(), []
while len(pairs) < 5000:
    i, j = r.randrange(n), r.randrange(n)
    if i < j and (i, j) not in seen:
        seen.add((i, j))
        pairs.append([order[j], order[i]])
args = [n, pairs]

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(2103)
n = 2000
order = list(range(n))
r.shuffle(order)
seen, pairs = set(), []
while len(pairs) < 4950:
    i, j = r.randrange(n), r.randrange(n)
    if i < j and (i, j) not in seen:
        seen.add((i, j))
        pairs.append([order[j], order[i]])
ring = sorted(r.sample(range(n), 50))
for k in range(50):
    i, j = ring[k], ring[(k + 1) % 50]
    if (i, j) not in seen:
        seen.add((i, j))
        pairs.append([order[j], order[i]])
r.shuffle(pairs)
args = [n, pairs]
tests.label: 2,000 courses with one 50-course loop
